definitions.explanation: Items or systems installed in a building or place for a particular purpose.

examples.japanese: このホテルは{設備|せつび}が{充実|じゅうじつ}している。
{工場|こうじょう}の{設備|せつび}を{新|あたら}しくした。
{冷暖房|れいだんぼう}{設備|せつび}が{整|ととの}っている。
examples.english: The air conditioning and heating facilities are in place.

notes:
{設備|せつび} refers to equipment, facilities, or installations that are set up in a building or location for a specific purpose. Composed of {設|せつ} (set up) + {備|び} (equip, prepare).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {設備|せつび}{投資|とうし}: capital investment (in equipment)
- {設備|せつび}を{整|ととの}える: to set up/prepare facilities
- {設備|せつび}が{充実|じゅうじつ}している: well-equipped
- {生産|せいさん}{設備|せつび}: production equipment
- {冷暖房|れいだんぼう}{設備|せつび}: HVAC facilities
- {消防|しょうぼう}{設備|せつび}: fire-fighting equipment
- {最新|さいしん}{設備|せつび}: latest/state-of-the-art equipment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {機器|きき}: equipment, devices (individual items)
- {施設|しせつ}: facility, institution (the building/place itself)
